reason: Mastermind is a repeatable instant-speed Pact exit that can also recast it. The deck already runs Swiftfoot Boots, and Greaves' shroud blocks our own auras and tricks.
Strangling Grasp is an edict each upkeep, so Obeka's extra upkeeps strip several permanents. Bloodsucker's 1-point ping is minor next to that.
Gisa turns our heavy removal into theft and returns the creatures on Obeka's extra upkeeps. Tormentor lets opponents choose the least painful option.
Chimera fixes Pact: order triggers so Pact resolves, then Chimera returns it to hand. It also rebuys Fugue and Implant. Prophet offers no exit.
Dracosaur turns each extra upkeep into two playable cards plus Treasure or tokens, usable in the second main. It's also a strong flier. Taigam's single selection is weaker.
Cloak permanently makes Obeka unblockable and shrouds it against spot removal. Key needs a discard every turn, costly in a control deck.
The engine is mostly enchantments: Virtue, Court, Fugue, Implant, Pact. Chimes returns all of them at once; Siege only recurs creatures.
Wait, Allure is B. Allure gains a counter per upkeep, so Obeka grows it fast into big theft. Outcast isn't theft.
Torch Song gains a counter every upkeep, so Obeka turns grow it fast. It's a repeatable, scaling burn engine. Geyser is a flexible one-shot that ignores the deck's engine.
Ambition triggers every extra upkeep for 6 life or two discards each, with no liability. Pact's modes run out fast under multiple upkeeps and risk the loss mode.
Fugue fills the theft role, stealing the table's best permanent and attacking with it each turn. Embereth is a strong clock but doesn't take anything.
Rollick is free instant-speed exile alongside the commander and protects the engine immediately. Implant is a slow, fragile aura that waits for an upkeep.
Puca's swaps Demonic Pact to an opponent while stealing value, the deck's named Pact kill. Vantress copies are cute but don't enable the donate plan.
Requiem grows with Obeka's extra upkeeps and destroys only the creatures we target, sparing Obeka. Blasphemous Act kills our own commander and board.
Recantation scales with upkeeps into a mass bounce and doubles as the Pact exit by returning Pact to hand. Aetherize is a one-time defensive trick.
Enslave steals the best creature on board immediately and permanently, plus an upkeep ping. Betrayal is cheap and Obeka speeds it, but it's slow without hits.
One mana to bounce Pact or save an engine piece; cleave matches Into the Roil's unkicked mode. Roil's kicker draw costs four mana.
Counters any spell type or kills creatures. Graveyards fill in a grindy game, and it fits UB perfectly. Negate misses creatures entirely.
Serves both roles: counters creatures/enchantments, or returns Pact and threatened engine enchantments to hand. Arcane Denial gives opponents two cards.
Flickering Pact returns it as a new object with modes reset. It also dodges removal on engine pieces. Swat is free protection but can't reset Pact.
